trial_court: 1st Civil Judge Class-1, Lakhnadaun, Distt.-Seoni in Civil Suit No.31-A/2016

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Jagdish Soni and others (husband, wife, plaintiff)

facts_of_case: The parties are Jagdish Soni and Raju. The relief claimed is declaration of share in the suit property. The trial court passed a judgment and decree which was reversed by the first appellate court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside a decree.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking to set aside a decree.

legal_principles.principle: The principle is that a party seeking to set aside a decree must establish sufficient grounds.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the principle is that a party seeking to set aside a decree must establish sufficient grounds.

outcome.final_order: Notice to respondents No.1 and 2 along with memo of appeal, substantial questions of law and I.A.No.6277/2023 application under Order 39 Rule 1 & 2 CPC.
